result_text:
I changed the `all_files.zip` export so the five scope entries are named after the configured aspect names. It compiles, but I haven't run any tests or tried a renamed aspect.

The change is in the zip-building block of `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It now takes the five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) and gets each file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same call that writes the loose `aspect_*.txt` files. Each file is read back under that name and added to the zip under it too.

With the default config the entries are unchanged: `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt`, `aspect_generated.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, `aspect_other.txt`, in that order. With the aspect renamed to "buildAndDeployment", the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `all_files.zip` should then be written again, so the `git-history.zip` step after it should no longer be skipped.
